subject.title: refactor(talk): return emitted events from the realtime session harness

question: Should the returned harness-event result types become supported public Plugin SDK exports now, or should this refactor keep them internal until the Gateway-managed session API has an approved public contract?
rationale: The diff changes a public Plugin SDK barrel, while the follow-on feature PR depends on these types; choosing a durable SDK contract is a maintainer product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the SDK result types
options.body: Treat the three exports as a supported additive Plugin SDK contract and review their naming, docs, and compatibility expectations together with the stacked session feature.

options.title: Keep the types internal
options.body: Remove the new Plugin SDK type exports and have the current internal relay use local or internal types until a separately approved SDK API needs them.

recommendation.title: Approve the SDK result types
recommendation.body: Treat the three exports as a supported additive Plugin SDK contract and review their naming, docs, and compatibility expectations together with the stacked session feature.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged harness-relay foundation and authored the stacked work that consumes the proposed SDK contract.
